result.summary: The application layout is mostly functional, but there is one major visual issue where the text for a restaurant name is getting clipped.

issues.description: The text 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated/clipped in the 'Fastest near you' section.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the container width, decrease the font size, or allow text wrapping for restaurant names to ensure the full name is visible to the user.
